maya: quick note — HelixCare requested an APAC-friendly enablement: a short twilight clinic (30m) + renewal health check next week. Can someone cover a 20:30 SGT slot?

andre: I can run 20:30 SGT on Wed. Will do 20m demo + 10m Q&A.

tess: Im happy to prepare a one-pager for renewal signals and share with AEs.

sam: Assign me to follow-up notes and feedback capture. I'll use the short template: top 2 friction points, ask, severity (low/med/high).

maya: Thanks — calendaring now. cs-bot, add a 24h reminder and set recording consent.

cs-bot: Reminder created, recording consent note added.
